integrity: The proof is a symbolic carry-increment and symmetry argument with an exhaustive length-four local-pattern obstruction, sharp palindrome witnesses, and a separate reversal-closure proof for m<=2. The standalone verifier checks explicit arithmetic constructions and independent finite factor enumerations, which are not used as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The claim classifies ordinary reflected factors of T_{b,m} and gives a new cutoff trichotomy. It uses and credits established factor complexity and the pre-existing binary-base special case. It does not classify generalized letter-negating anti-symmetries or supply a new complete formula for m=2 reflection complexity.
title: Arithmetic sharp cutoffs for reflected factors of generalized Thue–Morse words
